ana: Quick results from last night's RoPE scaling runs across Llama/Mixtral/Qwen on the dedicated pool. Ran linear / NTK / YARN variants + kernel swap to fused_attn_v2 and a new adaptive batching heuristic. TL;DR: NTK is safe-ish for Llama up to ~1.05x, Mixtral needs conservative linear scaling (~0.98) for long contexts; YARN gave token/sec wins but triggered KV cache duplication on >8k contexts.

mike: numbers?

ana: (typo) ana: attaching a compact summary from the overnight jobs:
```
model    variant  scale  ppl    tokens/s  tail95lat(ms)
mixtral  linear   0.98   12.1   42k       120
mixtral  ntk      1.08   11.9   44k       180  (unstable >8k)
llama2.1 ntk      1.05   10.8   48k        90
qwen2.5  yarn     1.20   13.5   46k       220  (kv dup observed)
```

raj: where did the kv duplication show up in the profile? memory graph?

ana: ana: quick snippet from the worker profiler:
```
[profiling] timestamp: 2025-11-06T03:12:08Z
worker=gw-12 kv_cache_bytes: pre=1.2G post=3.9G (per-worker)
callstack: kv_shard::clone_meta() x12 -> kv_alloc::reserve() -> attention::alloc_kv()
heap: +2.7G in kv_shard entries, refcount unexpectedly >1 for shards
```

katie: kernel selector behavior? why did fused_attn fall back?

ana: ana: fused_attn_v2 outperforms for median_seq_len <= 2048 and when kv_size per batch < 512MB. For sequences >2048 we hit a fallback to chunked_attention kernel (different memory pattern) which increased p95/p99. We changed selector to use median_seq_len + kv_size + recent_batch_variance as signals.

mike: batching heuristic changes?

ana: ana: implemented "adaptive_batch_cap":
- maintain moving p95 latency; if p95 > target -> cap max batch tokens to current batch size
- if tokens/sec < baseline for >30s and p95 < target -> increase cap by 10% up to a hard limit
Effect: +6-8% tokens/sec on mixed workloads, but p99 drifted up under sudden QPS spikes. Flagged behind feature flag.

perf-bot: perf-bot: post-deploy regression check: mixtral-serve @ canary: p50 -3% (seq<=512), p99 +9% (seq>4096).

raj: actionables?

ana: ana: proposed steps:
1) revert YARN for Mixtral (disabled on canary) until KV patch merges.
2) raj to dig into kv_shard clone/refcount path (priority P0).
3) katie to land kernel-selector tweak PR (make median_seq_len/window configurable per-model).
4) add unit test that simulates >8k context kv shard clone and asserts no duplication.
5) expose per-model "rope_policy" in model catalog (values: linear, ntk, yarn, safe_scale) and default to conservative values we found.

mike: sounds good. can we ship a hotfix that forces RoPE=linear for Mixtral on dedicated until tests pass?

ana: ana: yea I'll push a hotfix flag and roll it to dedicated pool tomorrow AM. Also adding a small eval harness run (1000 sequences sampled at 12k context) to the perf CI to catch regressions.

katie: note — Mixtral training config uses RoPE scale 1.0 in upstream; upstream evals didn't exercise 12k contexts. we should document "safe_range": Mixtral: <=1.0 for >8k, Llama: <=1.05, Qwen: prefer linear or yarn but cap yarn <=1.1.

ana: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll open the three PRs and tag you.

mike: :eye: please also include kernel selection metrics in the rollout dashboard (median_seq_len, kv_bytes, chosen_kernel) so we can correlate with tail spikes.
